eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 4:05 AM on AUG 23, 2023 Effective until 4:05 AM AUG 24, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: We are issuing a MANDATORY evacuation order for residents on Neale Oil Field Rd.  The fire is approximately 1 mile away.  Agencies continue to attempt to contain the fire at this time.  If you need transportation please contact our office at 337-463-3281 and we will have units in the area to help you get to a safer area.  Please use caution when leaving as others will be trying to do the same. Mandatory evacuation for resident on Neale Oilfield Road. Relocate per CAP alert.
